news.title: Bob Woodward reveals why he's naming sources in new book 'Secrets'
news.summary: For over five decades, veteran journalist Bob Woodward has exposed some of Washington's closely kept secrets. In his new memoir fittingly titled "Secrets," he lets us in on some of his own, and unmasks the anonymous sources that allowed him incredible access to ten American presidents. Amna Nawaz sat down with Woodward and discussed why he chose to name some of them now.
